purpose: 2D / hybrid prototype sprites and optional Tripo image references

plants.prompt: Create a single isolated game plant sprite on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background with alpha, no ground, no flowerpot, no scenery, no desktop, no text, no character, no border. Cute clean 2D storybook style, broad rounded shapes with gentle 2-3-tone painted shading, visually simple and toy-like but unmistakably illustrated not photorealistic. Thick smooth stems, plump simple leaf shapes, no fine vein texture, no realistic dirt or tiny details. Full plant including bottom of main stem centered with generous 8% transparent margin, portrait 3:4-ish composition. Only one plant. Crisp silhouette, large readable parts suitable for a small desktop game. The single entire plant must have a unified root origin at bottom center, leaves and flowers visibly connected to the stem. Premium charming game asset, cohesive muted pastel greens and warm cream. A small whimsical bell-flower plant, gently arching main stem with three large pendant apricot peach bell blossoms at distinct heights, 4-5 broad rounded sage-green leaves, one tiny cream bud. Bell flowers have scalloped round edges, sweet soft orange inner color. A compact elegant asymmetric silhouette, no fine stalk network.
